limitations: Synthetic one-layer inputs and small slot pool; no learned model state or full serving memory measurement.
Snapshot commit uses Torch gather/index_copy; these ratios do not compare the fused serving commit and are not an end-to-end speedup.
Both GPUs tested sequentially, not under TP2 inference.
Rotated ring fixture covers fold addressing; production circular writer, slot reuse and radix tracking are not integrated.
Serving integration and normal-stop/context/cache/cancellation/lifecycle qualification remain required.
Initial packet stopped during second-GPU capture after eight exact cases; corrected packet binds explicit per-device streams. Both attempts retained.
